Compared all twelve locales with deposit context, preserving rent and uncertain return-trip funds, product-specific withdrawal conditions and decision after comparison. Repaired Nepali catch-up metaphor and staff invitation in Hindi and Bengali.

Read parcel scheduling context and all twelve sets: friend currently traveling, next Thursday morning absence, clothing allows delayed dispatch, evening availability conditional on service options retained. Corrected Chinese present travel status and Thai indirect-question grammar.

Read overseas-school remittance context and all twelve sets: school must receive 500 dollars, sender wants separate fees, intermediary/receiving treatment checked, yen total estimate and method decision before order retained; no guaranteed fee treatment added.

Read thick-toast context and all twelve sets: one loaf into four including both ends, similar thickness, sample versus toaster slot and usual six-slice cut retained. Corrected Thai request to see slice thickness, keeping customer as observer.

Read expressway debris context and all twelve sets: passenger witness, southbound past central exit before next bridge, 10:05 left lane, husband avoids right, safe parking and unknown origin/following car retained. Corrected Nepali third-person negative for following vehicle.

Read booklet-and-disc context and all twelve sets: recorded-video disc in thin case/rear pocket, protective pouch with same envelope, two contents declared, nonurgent rate choice and weighing including disc retained. No paper-only eligibility or specific service invented.

Read all12 against Japanese: seasoned small pieces versus whole toasted nori, ten halved into twenty for four people, five-sheet alternative and storage closure retained. No material semantic correction needed.
Read all12: lawn rake rather than broom, light tips to spare soil, branches in basket/leaves in open bag, designated collection and returned rake preserved. No material semantic correction needed.

Read all12: last-summer festival search using drum photo, July/August bound volumes for onsite reading only, pencil loan, August page/date note and two-volume/pencil return maintained. No semantic correction needed.

Read all12: tight sleeve, straight-arm pressure, disclosure of blood-thinning medication taken this morning, repeat nurse check, bleeding-stop confirmation before slowly lowering sleeve and reporting recurrence maintained. AI language review only.

Read all12: secondhand bicycle shop purchase with receipt, unclear anti-theft sticker does not establish completed registration; frame number differs, shop consultation and possible extra documents preserved. No semantic correction needed.

Read all12: dry envelope adhesive, two photos protected from folds and glue, writing-table permission, sealed corners checked before weighing, 110 yen payment and returned glue preserved. No semantic correction needed.
